request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Pallas by TxPipe for 12 months of Year 2 maintenance of Cardano core Rust libraries.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for Pallas maintenance, with an additional 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee for a total withdrawal of 540,750 ADA.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The proposal states Pallas is used by ecosystem projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The document reports Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with GitHub and crates.io links provided for verification.
The planned work covers maintenance, community support, external contribution review, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal asserts that the requested withdrawal does not, alone or in aggregate at submission time, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect states that audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through its administration fee and third-party oversight.
TxPipe is disclosed as having received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals in Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Treasury funds would be administered through Sundae Labs smart contract tooling with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-like role thresholds, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month continuation of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, describes Pallas as shared Cardano Rust infrastructure, provides some externally checkable adoption and governance references, and outlines Intersect-managed smart-contract custody and oversight controls.
